Motivational statement; not verifiable from photos.

risks.risk: Bundle mismatch: the photos show a stack of multiple different titles, but the seller’s offer is in “5 copies” and “10 copies” without confirming whether that means 5/10 different titles, 5/10 total books, or 5/10 copies of the same set.
risks.proof: A photo showing the exact bundle count laid out (5 books in one bundle, 10 books in another) with titles visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: pay for a smaller/less complete set than expected (treat as only the visible titles, not a guaranteed full bundle).

risks.risk: Condition risk: photos don’t show page condition, missing pages, water damage, heavy highlighting, or torn covers.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of 2–3 books’ spines and inner pages (open to the first 5–10 pages) showing any damage/markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume used with noticeable wear/markings.

risks.risk: Edition/ISBN mismatch: titles are visible but editions/revisions aren’t confirmed; different editions can affect value.
risks.proof: Photo of the back cover or copyright/ISBN page for at least 2 books.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume mixed/unknown editions.

risks.risk: Quantity/availability risk: seller may not have enough copies to fulfill 10-book bundle as advertised.
risks.proof: Photo of the remaining stock count or a video showing the books being packed for a 10-book order.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume limited availability and treat as single bundle only.

proof_requests: Confirm what “5 copies” and “10 copies” means (5/10 total books vs 5/10 different titles vs copies of the same set).
Send a photo of the exact 5-book bundle laid out with titles readable; then the exact 10-book bundle laid out.
Send close-ups of condition: open inner pages (first pages) and spine/cover corners for at least 2 books.
Send ISBN/copyright-page photos for at least 2 titles to confirm editions.
response.reason: The photos show multiple book titles, but they do not confirm the exact bundle composition/count promised by the seller (5 vs 10) or the condition/edition details that determine value. Without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
